review_candidates.title: MEP Project Engineer -LB - Beirut
review_candidates.description: MEP Project Engineer Role Description The MEP Project Engineer role is a full-time, site-based position. The MEP Project Engineer will support the planning, coordination, execution, testing, and handover of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works for building and infrastructure projects. The role will ensure that MEP installations are delivered in line with approved drawings, specifications, project schedules, quality requirements, and applicable safety standards. Responsibilities include reviewing MEP drawings, specifications, BOQs, shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements; identifying clashes, omissions, and constructability issues; and coordinating technical resolutions with consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and the site project team. The MEP Project Engineer will monitor site progress, inspect works, verify material compliance, and support testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover activities. The role involves close coordination among mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire and life-safety, ELV, civil, structural, and architectural disciplines. The MEP Project Engineer will provide technical input to the Project Manager, support procurement and planning activities, prepare progress reports and technical trackers, and contribute to the timely resolution of site issues and design coordination matters. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in MEP engineering, site supervision, construction, fit-out, or building-services projects. Strong understanding of MEP systems, including HVAC, plumbing, drainage, water supply, firefighting, electrical distribution, lighting, power, and ELV systems. Demonstrated ability to read and coordinate MEP drawings, specifications, BOQs, shop drawings, technical submittals, and method statements. Experience coordinating MEP works with civil, structural, architectural, and specialist contractors on active construction sites. Working knowledge of site installation practices, quality-control requirements, testing, commissioning, snagging, and project handover procedures. Ability to identify coordination clashes, construction constraints, technical risks, and practical solutions before they affect programme or quality. Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Office, and project-documentation tools; familiarity with Revit/BIM coordination is an advantage. Knowledge of relevant international and local MEP codes, standards, and health and safety requirements. Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams. Good Knowledge of Electrical Apply Here: https://forms.gle/uu9futZ8cM4Qgif59

review_candidates.description: Who We Are At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling or a finish line. Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation. Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success: Runner First - We act in the best interest of the runner Word is Bond - We do what we say we’ll do Champion Heart - We give our all in everything we do There is no “I” in Run - We stay generous with our humanity Keep Moving - We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic! We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement — because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there. Your Job As an M3 Functional Analyst you will be the primary person responsible for the Infor M3 ERP in the EMEA region. The ERP is the core system supporting our operations so you will participate in many projects that will help us grow our wholesale and eCommerce businesses, evolve our supply chain, and improve efficiency. You will frequently partner with Sales, Customer Service, Logistics and Finance to deliver new capabilities. You will collaborate with the global technology team to support the ERP system worldwide and support in global improvement projects such as system upgrades. Paramount responsibility is ensuring that customer facing transactions are processed effectively. You will also assist with EDI onboarding and processing to ensure all transactions are processed timely. Your Responsibilities Participate the design of integrated business processes along with the guidance of Global leads to provide new capabilities and streamline operations for Sales, Finance, Customer Service, Logistics, retailers, and consumers. Collect business requirements and maintain business process flows as they are implemented in M3 and related systems ensuring clarity and alignment with stakeholder expectations. Create functional specifications and collaborate with technology team members on implementation. Participate in testing new or updated functions alongside business users Participate in regular Super User meetings to discuss system enhancements and necessary business process adjustments. Monitor system performance using available tools to help identify issues related to stability and scalability. Escalate concerns and contribute to evaluating potential tools or improvements. Support system upgrades, fixes and enhancements while ensuring Brooks change control processes are followed for approvals, planning, testing, documentation, and implementation Assist in investigating initial root cause analysis on production application failures and support necessary remediation of defects. Create and maintain documentation including system context diagrams, system and data interfaces, and process flows. Support automation efforts by developing and maintaining scripts to increase efficiency Partner and foster collaboration with the wider Global IT team based in Seattle. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or relevant major. 3+ years of experience implementing, administering, managing and/or supporting enterprise IT applications, preferably in the consumer goods industry. 3+ years of experience working with Infor M3 as a Systems or Functional Analyst. Functional knowledge of supply chain business processes within the Infor M3 ERP system. Business requirements gathering skills are essential including the ability to support the design and configure business processes. Ability to query databases such as DB2 and SQL server. Preferred knowledge of M3 technologies such as business engine database, Grid, Infor ION, MEC and Stream serve. Experience with development methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc. Strong troubleshooting skills; tenacity and hunger for finding the root cause of a problem. Keen attention to detail in planning, organizing, and executing tasks, while still seeing the big picture and understanding how the pieces fit together. Ability to learn new applications and technologies. Strong communication and presentation skills, ability to partner with key business stakeholders on different levels along with ability to tailor approach based on audience and message. Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills that encourage and build trust for effective working relationships across the company. Knowledge of ITIL service management framework and best practices for systems administration. Diligent and reliable; available to provide after-hours support as needed. At Brooks, we celebrate diversity & equity. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment, and encourage people of all backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and skills to apply. Brooks is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, the presence of a sensory, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military status, marital status, pregnancy or child birth, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, political ideology, or any other non-merit based factors.

review_candidates.title: Investigations Specialist, UK, Worldwide Operations Investigations
review_candidates.description: Description Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented professional who wants to join our team as an Investigations Specialist. In this key role, you will provide investigations as a service across Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), investigating theft and fraud incidents as well as policy violations and security-related incidents. Key job responsibilities Own the intake, investigation, and resolution of theft and fraud investigations Create accurate and timely initial, interim, and final investigation reports Create investigations within the approved case management system in a timely manner Support the Investigations Manager and Senior Investigations Manager with difficult theft and fraud investigations A day in the life As an Investigations Specialist, you will join a team of professionals who provide investigations as a service to business customers across Amazon’s end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss. On a daily basis, you will investigate theft and fraud incidents, policy violations, and security-related events. To initiate an investigation, you receive an escalation or incident, either proactively or reactively. You will then assess, triage, and prioritise the nature of the incident by working out its severity, impact, scope, and scale. During your work, you will conduct investigative actions to identify trends, patterns, and root causes with the aim of compiling all relevant information into an evidential packet. You will also seek to identify key person(s) of interest and conduct interviews, when required, to resolve your investigation. Upon completion, you will create a final investigation report which will support the business with an actionable, meaningful, and proportionate incident resolution. Throughout, you will act as one of the principal points of contact and subject matter experts for internal and external departments (e.g., legal, human resources, operations, outside counsel) and contribute towards the overall Security and Loss Prevention goals and objectives. During the course of your work, you may be required to travel both domestically and internationally across EMEA to support other teams and business units. About The Team Working in partnership with our stakeholders, Security and Loss Prevention secures the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promotes security during business conversations. The Investigations team is a support function to Security and Loss Prevention Field Operations with responsibility over the management, development, and conclusion of investigative activity. Our team provides support, guidance, and direction to our customers on a broad range of investigative issues, ranging from theft of inventory, workplace incidents, and surface transportation events to complex, sophisticated fraud involving multiple bad actors, stakeholders, and marketplaces. Basic Qualifications Experience in fraud/risk investigations Experience identifying and solving complex problems through data analysis Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment, or experience with Microsoft Office products and applications A relevant degree or degree equivalent in a security-related field Preferred Qualifications Relevant industry certification (e.g., Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI)) Wicklander-Zulawski Non-Confrontational Interview Accreditation (Level 1 or Level 2) Basic SQL knowledge as well as understanding of how to write, extract, and ingest large-scale data queries Relevant experience building, iterating on, and submitting investigative case files Driver’s license Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
